---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing the CampusLoop university events website to maintain its brand identity, design system, content and functionality.
---

1. Brand name: CampusLoop. Tagline: "Your Campus. Your Community. Your Events." Use a youthful, welcoming and professional tone.
2. Primary colours: Deep navy (#172554), vibrant purple (#6D5CE8), soft lavender (#F3F0FF), white (#FFFFFF) and dark grey (#333333).
3. Use Poppins for headings and Inter for body text. Maintain clear typography and readability.
4. Every page must include a navigation bar, main content area and footer.
5. The homepage must feature a hero section, upcoming events, event categories and an introduction to CampusLoop.
6. Display events as attractive cards with event names, categories, dates, times, venues and short descriptions.
7. Include categories for Workshops, Competitions, Social Events and Networking.
8. Use consistent date formatting such as 25 November 2026 and 5:00 PM. Do not invent real university events or claim fictional events are officially endorsed by LUMS.
9. Include a working registration form with name, email and event selection. Validate required fields and display confirmation after submission.
10. Make navigation links and buttons functional. Never include empty links or non-functional buttons.
11. Use rounded cards, subtle shadows, generous spacing and responsive layouts for mobile and desktop.
12. Never use fabricated testimonials, fake statistics or misleading claims.
